checks.evidence: Both selected workspace assets are 1536x1024 RGB PNG files with recorded SHA-256 hashes.
Front preserves centered maker, square table/wall relationship, direct frontal face and cup axis.
Side preserves the original maker-right one-eye profile, lateral body silhouette, camera height and 3:2 composition.
Same face, freckles, tied-back dark hair, charcoal shirt and apron, downward gaze and neutral focused production-role expression remain across the pair.
Same pale wall, diagonal daylight, stainless worktable, idle stainless sealer and warm-neutral grade remain; equipment changes sides consistently with the camera axis.
No collar, sleeve, label, sticker, loose paper ring, paper card or spare paper component remains on the cup or foreground table in either image.

Both frames show a low-wide lightly tapered clear molded cup with visible dense ivory food, transparent rim/wall edges and stable foot; it reads as yogurt packaging rather than perfume, cosmetics or lab glass.
Both frames retain a thin flat full-perimeter foil already sealed to the rim with one asymmetric tab; no loose foil or reclosure state appears.
MORA and THYME HONEY are neutral black directly on the transparent wall with no opaque, white, frosted or paper-shaped backing and no recipe-color ink.
Both selected frames spell MORA and THYME HONEY correctly; MORA is quiet/small and THYME HONEY is the larger recipe line. No generated numbers, dates, barcodes or extra copy appear.

Maker looks down and lightly contacts opposite cup sides/base, reading as alignment, adhesion and clarity inspection of an already printed/filled/sealed unit; no printing, labeling, sleeving, filling, sealing, coding, wiping or peeling is shown.
Hands retain plausible anatomy and contact; cup foot and hands cast coherent shadows and do not float or intersect the package.
No visible printer head, roller, pad, screen, registration gauge, scale number, test readout or claimed SOP is invented. The idle sealer remains environmental continuity only.
No apothecary grid, amber bottle, perfume mimic, cosmetic jar, lab glassware, kraft, wood, twine, sepia, rustic patina or heroic artisan pose appears.

pair_continuity_note: The images communicate the same maker and the same final-inspection action from frontal and strict side axes. They are directional editorial companions, not photogrammetric proof of one frozen instant or an approved industrial sequence.
residual_release_gates: Replace or re-photograph from approved physical prototypes before treating cup wall, foil, print opacity or food appearance as production evidence.
Validate actual direct-print method, ink/cure, nested set-off, food contact/migration, adhesion, condensation rub, taper registration and six-fill contrast; the images do not close these gates.
Validate transparent pack light/barrier/seal/shelf-life performance and Black Sesame legibility before public pack claims.
Keep maker caption generic; never identify the generated person as founder, employee or source evidence.
